pages.title: Rockslide Pass - Valley Wiki
pages.text: The Rockslide Pass is the only path from the south meadow to the Old Shrine in the north-east. A rockslide closed the pass in early spring. The repair crew clears it on the morning of day 5; before day 5 nothing can get through and every attempt to push past the rocks is wasted time. Once the pass opens, the shrine chest is a short walk north up the east corridor (tile x 11). While the pass is closed, the south meadow's soil is fine for early crops.

pages.title: Old Shrine - Valley Wiki
pages.text: The Old Shrine chest stands at the north-east end of the pass, tile x 11, y 1. Travelers can reach it only after the Rockslide Pass reopens on day 5 of spring. The notice board by the meadow well posts the same repair schedule for anyone who walks up and reads it.

pages.title: Spring Crops - Valley Wiki
pages.text: Parsnips are the classic first-week crop: till with the hoe, plant the seed, water the soil, and the crop matures overnight if it was watered. Watered soil is what matters; unwatered crops stall.
